texts.orig: The more startups I work with, the more I’m convinced that Justin is right. While starting a company has never been easier, and building a great product has become table stakes, getting your product in front of the right people efficiently—getting people to even know you exist—is increasingly what separates the haves from the have-nots. As Peter Thiel once put it, “Poor distribution—not product—is the number one cause of failure.”
